build_audit_log_response_model: build a pydantic model to represent a single audit log entry with id, action, and changed_by fields
build_paginated_audit_log_response_model: build a pydantic model to represent paginated audit logs with page, page_size, and total_pages fields
create_audit_log_entry: create an AuditLogResponse instance with id, updated_at, changed_by, action, table_name, and object_id
create_paginated_audit_logs: create a PaginatedAuditLogResponse instance with a list of AuditLogResponse entries and pagination metadata
review_audit_log_models: review the AuditLogResponse and PaginatedAuditLogResponse pydantic models for audit logging endpoint response schemas
